name: The story
notes: The opening story, told over black before the game starts in Dustmere.

lines.text: LONG AGO THE ASHEN KING CARVED THE KINGDOM OF UNDERHIVE OUT OF THE DARK.
THEN CAME THE GLARE: A FORGOTTEN LIGHT THAT WHISPERED IN THE DREAMS OF EVERY BUG AND BURNED THEIR MINDS AWAY.
THE KING FORGED VESSELS OF PURE VOID, HOLLOW AND SILENT, TO LOCK THE GLARE INSIDE ONE OF THEM FOREVER.
THE CHOSEN ONE, THE HOLLOW VESSEL, WAS SEALED IN THE BLACK TEMPLE. THE REST WERE CAST INTO THE ABYSS.
BUT THE SEAL IS CRACKING. AND FROM THE ABYSS, ONE SMALL VESSEL HAS CLIMBED BACK UP...
